tools.name: get_adi_composite
tools.description: Fetch the latest quarterly reading of the American Distress Index (ADI) composite. Returns composite score (0-100), zone, composite Z-score, and the 5-component breakdown (Buffer, Debt Stress, Financial Conditions, Cost Pressure, Labor) with Z-scores and point contributions. Updated quarterly.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_indicators" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
